import os,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='review-inspection-ordinary-reviewer-',dir='.cache')).resolve()/'flow'
args=['python3','tests/rust_native_reviewer.py','--binary',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_BINARY'],'--output',str(p)]
args+=['--profile',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_PROFILE']]
subprocess.run(args,check=True)
r=json.loads((p/'result.json').read_text());assert r['status']=='PASS'
print('INSPECTION_ORDINARY_REVIEWER_PASS '+str(p))
